summary: Datavault AI Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a binding term sheet with Scilex Holding Company for the proposed sale of 837 Bitcoin held in a digital wallet for $50 million. The Purchase Price will be paid with an initial $30 million cash payment and the remaining $20 million in quarterly installments through December 2028. Scilex may pay in cash, its common stock, or subsidiary securities. No definitive agreement has been finalized; the transaction is subject to negotiation, regulatory approvals, board approval, and market conditions. There is no assurance of consummation. This is a routine asset sale filing, not a special situation change of control or restructuring event.
